nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs the full TradeIQ paper-trading cycle every 5 minutes through a public bridge URL.

nodes.name: Bridge Health Check
nodes.notes: Requires n8n variable TRADEIQ_BRIDGE_URL, for example https://abc-123.ngrok-free.app

nodes.name: Fetch Market Data
nodes.notes: Calls data_fetcher.fetch_and_store() through the public bridge and saves yfinance data into trading.db.

nodes.name: Run Sentiment
nodes.notes: Scores Google News RSS sentiment and saves rows in the local SQLite DB.

nodes.name: Run ML Predictions
nodes.notes: Runs ensemble ML predictions and saves latest BUY/SELL/HOLD signals.

nodes.name: Load Latest Signals
nodes.notes: Reads latest saved signals from ml_predictions.

nodes.name: Route Signals
nodes.notes: Groups latest signals for reporting and downstream notification.

nodes.name: Execute Paper Trades
nodes.notes: Runs BUY/SELL agents with risk controls in paper mode.

nodes.name: Portfolio Status
nodes.notes: Reads cash, starting balance, open positions, and recent trades.

nodes.name: Build Cycle Report
nodes.notes: Final output. Add Telegram, Email, Discord, or Google Sheets nodes after this node.
